ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate the central surface area (approx. 85%), bounded by a low-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region; solid black band along the trailing edge perimeter extending into the tips; localized black clusters and linear streaks dispersed across both lobes; distinctive dark 'C' shaped mark on the lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees at the point of lobe convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5-20 pixels; topography is characterized by jagged, non-uniform peaks and valleys along the entire visible trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, extending symmetrically outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (10-30 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle scarring localized in the lower-central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks (rake marks) ranging from 50-150 pixels in length, primarily concentrated on the right lobe and lower sections of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and circular parasitic/barnacle scars; irregular, ragged trailing edge suggesting significant wear or historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique semi-circular dark marking located in the lower-inner quadrant of the left lobe; concentrated group of small black punctate spots near the lower center where the lobes meet the peduncle.
